pr_title: Clarify comment about camera coordinate system
pr_body:
# Objective

Clarify the comment about the camera's coordinate system in `examples/3d/generate_custom_mesh.rs` by explicitly stating which axes point where.
Fixes #13018

## Solution

Copy the wording from #13012 into the example.

issue_context.title: Clarify camera coordinate system further
issue_context.body:
[Another PR](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/12991) added a similar comment, might be good to update that comment to match the one from this PR

_Originally posted by @IceSentry in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/13012#issuecomment-2063036169_

review_comments: This example isn't about the camera, so the camera's axis-orientation doesn't seem especially pertinent to me. Is there a reason why it belongs here?

The issue was specifically about making this comment match a similar comment in the Camera3d docs. Personally, I think it's a helpful change to explicitly spell out which axis points where for people to understand the mesh below.

It's relevant in the sense that when making a custom mesh, you might care about it's orientation when spawning and knowing the camera coordinate system is relevant for that. I agree that it's not the ideal place, but it was added by a user that ran into this problem and that's where they were looking for it.
